title: CardUpdated
description: The current CardUpdated contract. Four payload fields carry only the card state a consumer can use. The embossed cardholder name remains on the synchronous card surface but no event consumer needs it, so the outbox never persists it and the broker never receives it. Five envelope fields precede the payload. additionalProperties is false and maxProperties is declared, so an unknown top-level property is refused and a producer cannot hide a Primary Account Number, a card verification value, a cardholder name or any other undeclared field inside a known event type. CardUpdated version 1 remains governed for old records.
$comment: CARD-CVV-CD PIC 9(03) and CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME PIC X(50) remain in the card aggregate and appear in no property of this document.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version matching the -v2 suffix.

occurredAt.description: The producer timestamp in Coordinated Universal Time.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier and Kafka message key.

accountId.description: The account identifier from CARD-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11).

maskedCardNumber.description: The card number with twelve mask characters and the last four digits visible.

expirationDate.description: The card expiry date, ten characters from CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE PIC X(10).

activeStatus.description: The one-character active status, carried without interpretation.

extensions.description: Optional bounded additive extension values. Sensitive property names and values are refused by the shared serde gate.
